label: Along reflection questions
attribution: From "Along Reflection Questions" (Gradient Learning / Chan Zuckerberg Initiative and partners: Transcend, Black Teacher Collaborative, Search Institute, Character Lab, Re-imagining Migration). Each prompt carries its author.
usage_note: The source document's "How to use" section invites teachers to reuse these questions in other tools they regularly use with students. Per-prompt author attribution is preserved here and must be kept through any refactor. Not legal advice — see docs/LIBRARY-FIRST-PLAN.md §4.
excluded_note: The "Wellbeing at school" collection (9 questions) is deliberately NOT ingested yet — those prompts are tender and need the teacher-only-visibility default designed first (docs/LIBRARY-FIRST-PLAN.md workstream B2).

decks.label: Fun & favorites

Something dramatic

decks.label: Relevance & motivation
decks.description: Does this matter to you? Honest reads on why (or whether) learning lands.

prompts.text: Does what we're learning in class matter to you? Pick what's closest to how you feel.
choices: No, I don't know why we learn this.
Not much. A few things are interesting.
A bit. I wish it felt more helpful.
Yes, I think this will help me later.

prompts.text: Is what we're learning in class connected to your life or community? Pick what's closest to how you feel.

Yes, it feels connected to me.

prompts.text: Lately, has what we've learned in class felt more connected to your life or community? Pick what's closest to how you feel.
choices: No, I still don't see any connection.
I see more connection to my life.
I see more connection to my community.
It's always felt connected to me.
prompts.author: Transcend

prompts.text: Over time, have you seen more connection between what we learn in class and what you really care about?
prompts.author: Transcend

prompts.text: What's something you're looking forward to? It can be big or small, soon or far in the future.

prompts.text: How are you feeling about what's coming up soon in school? Pick what's closest to how you feel.
choices: Nervous
Optimistic
Stressed
Something else, or I'm not sure

prompts.text: When was the last time you made a mistake? What did you do to learn from that mistake?
prompts.author: Search Institute

prompts.text: Think about the work you've done recently in class. How do you feel about it? What's one thing you're proud of?

Something to fidget with
Peace and quiet

prompts.text: In our class, are you able to learn at your own pace? Pick what's closest to how you feel.

Yes, I can do what works for me.

I know what I need, but I can't get it.
Sometimes I do, but not always.
Yes, I have what I need.

I've always been able to do what I need.
